# PLOS Wells supporting data (S2)

`25_Undeciphered(Indus).csv` and `Keylist_Udeciphered_Indus.pdf` are two files
extracted, unmodified, from the S2 Data archive of:

Ashraf, Md. I., & Sinha, S. (2018). The "handedness" of language: Directional
symmetry breaking of sign usage in words. *PLOS ONE* 13(1): e0190735.
https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0190735
(S2 Data: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0190735.s010)

Published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The rest of the archive (keylists
and sequences for other scripts) is not included. Checksums are in
`SOURCE_MANIFEST.md`.
